1.web: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.
1.asv: Masters, render unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.

2.web: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching therein with thanksgiving;
2.asv: Continue stedfastly in prayer, watching therein with thanksgiving;

3.web: praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds;
3.asv: withal praying for us also, that God may open unto us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds;

4.web: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.
4.asv: that I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.

5.web: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.
5.asv: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.

6.web: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.
6.asv: Let your speech be always with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer each one.

7.web: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.
7.asv: All my affairs shall Tychicus make known unto you, the beloved brother and faithful minister and fellow-servant in the Lord:

8.web: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,
8.asv: whom I have sent unto you for this very purpose, that ye may know our state, and that he may comfort your hearts;

9.web: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.
9.asv: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things that are done here.

10.web: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark, the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received commandments, “if he comes to you, receive him”),
10.asv: Aristarchus my fellow-prisoner saluteth you, and Mark, the cousin of Barnabas (touching whom ye received commandments; if he come unto you, receive him),

11.web: and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for the Kingdom of God who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.
11.asv: and Jesus that is called Justus, who are of the circumcision: these only are my fellow-workers unto the kingdom of God, men that have been a comfort unto me.

12.web: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
12.asv: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ Jesus, saluteth you, always striving for you in his prayers, that ye may stand perfect and fully assured in all the will of God.

13.web: For I testify about him, that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.
13.asv: For I bear him witness, that he hath much labor for you, and for them in Laodicea, and for them in Hierapolis.

14.web: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas greet you.
14.asv: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas salute you.

15.web: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the assembly that is in his house.
15.asv: Salute the brethren that are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church that is in their house.

16.web: When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans; and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.
16.asv: And when this epistle hath been read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye also read the epistle from Laodicea.

17.web: Tell Archippus, “Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.”
17.asv: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it.

18.web: The salutation of me, Paul, with my own hand: remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.
18.asv: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you.
